title: "Skunk Works Design Staff" – Lockheed drafting room photo (Chapter 2, p. 46)
description: Dark black-and-white photograph of a long drafting room with rows of drawing tables under overhead fluorescent light fixtures, with draftsmen working at the boards. Captioned "Skunk Works Design Staff." It appears in Chapter 2 of the CIA U-2 program history, alongside text on Kelly Johnson's December 1954 specifications for the new high-altitude aircraft.
